comment: Peer-network link map (MVP Profile 0.2, section 3.3). No external peer networks are bound yet: the sentinel_watchdog network currently calls only its own agents and same-origin site actions. When a peer is added, its symbolic name used in the network definition maps here to the peer network URL, in the form <peer site base>/<network name>, and the peer origin is added to allowed_peers in agent-manifest.json.
